hero.title: Savor the Authentic Taste of Andhra at Andhra Ruchulu, Kumarapark
hero.subtitle: Discover a culinary journey through traditional South Indian delicacies, prepared with passion and authentic spices.

about.title: Our Culinary Journey
about.paragraph1: At Andhra Ruchulu, Kumarapark, we are dedicated to bringing the vibrant and rich flavors of Andhra cuisine directly to your plate. Our chefs meticulously craft each dish using time-honored recipes and the freshest, locally sourced ingredients, ensuring an authentic taste that transports you to the heart of South India.
about.paragraph2: More than just a meal, dining with us is an experience. From fiery curries to aromatic biryanis and wholesome thalis, every item on our menu is a testament to the diverse culinary heritage of Andhra Pradesh. Join us for an unforgettable gastronomic adventure where tradition meets taste.
